latest_final: The apparent loss of university courses is a pun. The “student” was not choosing HKU classes but the food courses of a meal. Those courses were served progressively during the evening: each dish was brought out, eaten, and then cleared or replaced by the next course. By the end of that single evening, every course had been served and removed, so there were no courses left. That is why “all my courses were gone in one evening”—the meal’s courses had all been consumed and cleared away, not the student’s academic course registrations.
